items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an attacker to leverage incorrect authorization to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. It has been added to CISA's KEV catalog due to active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via StyleSmuggler Zero-Day
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. It has been actively exploited in the wild, affecting all versions from 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues.

items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. Amasty issued a security release for dozens of extensions, including this critical flaw.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique, bypassing validation and potentially leading to remote code execution. Attacks have been observed in the wild, with a fix released in Magento 2.4.9.

items.id: Mirasvit Cache Warmer PHP Object Injection
items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension. This vulnerability could lead to remote code execution.
